assessments.scope: Tincture remaining potency, integer liquid and dose quantization
assessments.assessment: A one-milliunit conditional request applies a fraction to remaining potency while rounding liquid removal up to a whole millilitre and rounding administration to milliunits with a minimum nonzero dose. At assumed potency 0.1 the modeled decrement is about 0.0001 standard dose while the minimum recorded administration is 0.001. A 150-request example requires every request and patient guard to succeed; it was not executed. The selected normal browser button sends 100, not 1, milliunits.

assessments.scope: Measured zero versus absent container occupancy volume
assessments.assessment: The native adapter converts a computed zero millilitre measurement to None, while core occupancy treats None as full exterior volume and admits Some(0). An apple exterior of 225 mL scaled to two millionths floors to zero. A concrete capacity consequence requires a supported retained amount, parent placement and capacity; intended sub-millilitre policy remains open.

assessments.scope: Investigation participant clocks, partial advancement and exact-MAX plan boundary
assessments.assessment: The selected time helper returns the leader minute without aligning existing participant clocks. In the interrupted path the receipt subtracts the leader start from the maximum retained participant clock; under the stated symbolic offset and partial-advance conditions this can include a pre-existing offset. Separately, the planner treats an end exactly at StrategicMinute::MAX as exhausted; if all native advances then report complete, its adapter reaches a later error. Supported combined states, rollback and intended duration/final-minute policies remain open. A terminal preview at equality can lose the terminal flag, while a false actual settlement is checked before completion effects.
assessments.history: Original 059 q2337 remains open; frozen PL13-257 delegated reads and root adoption retain their own attribution. The exact-MAX and participant-clock paths have different first operations; itinerary and preparation exhaustion records are context, not automatic aliases.

assessments.scope: Case occupancy and outbreak presence at a character minute
assessments.assessment: Changing case site closes an existing occupancy then inserts a key based on character, personal minute and site. A conditional leave and return within one minute can reuse an earlier closed key. A zero safe movement prefix provides a conditional same-minute exit path, not an established supported re-entry. A preceding outbreak helper can also skip an already existing same-minute presence key. Database uniqueness outcome, transaction rollback, impact and intended chronology remain open.
